_comment: Roster page per school, keyed by the same normalized team name
update-seed.py's norm_team() produces: lower-cased, dots removed,
'state' shortened to 'st'. There is no pattern to athletics domains
(kuathletics.com, uhcougars.com, goshockers.com), so this map is written
by hand and verified by the scrape log rather than guessed at runtime.
The path is not uniform either: most schools use /sports/womens-volleyball/,
but UCF uses /sports/volleyball/. Guessing the domain is not enough - each
entry has to be confirmed against the log.
A team missing from this map is skipped, never an error.
Arizona St. and Texas Tech are mapped correctly but yield no roster, and
the cause is on their side rather than in the parser. Their servers never
send the data: Texas Tech's Nuxt payload for the roster route comes back
at 56 bytes, and Arizona St. requests only icons and image zones. Ruled
out across four runs - the URL, the parser, rows hidden behind the view
toggles (there are none), a JSON fetch we were not capturing, and a
user-agent contradicting its own Client Hints headers. Their pages are
saved as scraped/roster-miss-*.html for whoever picks this up next.
